what: The owner's D188 (2026-11-19, exact links only; labels re-confirmed after the upgrade) and the red team's batch 2 and its addendum, built before Codex CR-2026-11-15-GATE-FIXES Pass 15, planted by hand in stages (D152) as in mutation-hand-check-f3882b4.json: the tests of the earlier receipts that caught the defect first, then the related modules, then the whole suite.
scope: every defect new or re-anchored since 69ab30b, every defect whose anchor lies in a function or statement the build changed in careeros/cli.py, careeros/demo/world.py, careeros/discovery/alerts.py, careeros/discovery/board_discovery.py, careeros/discovery/lead_resolution.py, careeros/discovery/manual_intake.py, careeros/discovery/saved.py, careeros/normalize/posting.py, careeros/normalize/sanitize.py, careeros/pipeline.py, careeros/qualify/gate.py, careeros/review/applications.py, careeros/review/assist.py, careeros/review/dismiss.py, careeros/review/labels.py, careeros/review/packages.py, careeros/review/report.py (scope13.py), and every defect whose catching tests in the earlier receipts D188 changed or removed (scope17_tests.py)
note: round 17 planted plain copies of the worktree at the code commit, with the whole-suite baseline taken in them (not carried over); defects outside the scope keep their results in the earlier receipts (mutation-hand-check-f3882b4.json and those before it)
